name: Tali: A Roman Empire Game of Chance
storyline: Attention all Romans! In celebration of Saturnalia, all are invited to take part in a tournament of TALI. Should you prove worthy you could find yourself showered in glory and riches, and earn the chance to face Gaius Julius Caesar Augustus himself!
